title: Coding agents are modernizing scientific software

title: Ponytail pushes coding agents to write less code
summary: The open-source agent ruleset favors reuse, standard library features, native platform tools, and the smallest implementation that safely works.

summary: The multi-model chat product offers pay-per-message access and lets people switch model providers without maintaining separate subscriptions.
